property_summary: Put() must never alter the contract's configuration state: after any Put call the public getter c.MinSum() still equals 1 ether (the initial value), but the buggy version overwrites MinSum with the deposited msg.value, breaking this for deposits of amount != 1 ether.
change_summary: Insert `MinSum = msg.value;` so the public getter Put() returns the last deposited amount instead of 1 ether after a Put call.
